summary_bullets: Ban per-turn task-output polling in AGENTS.md and orchestrator-never.md rule #3, with CI pins on both delivery paths
Harden hook-anti-read-poll.sh for Read|Bash task-output polling with suffix-tolerant Bash matching and a 600s token-keyed window

commit_message:
Close orchestrator per-turn task-output polling gap (#3195)

Name the manual per-turn read shape in AGENTS.md and orchestrator-never.md, pin both with CI, and harden hook-anti-read-poll.sh for Bash reads of tasks/<id>.output with token-keyed counting and Read|Bash PostToolUse registration.
